svg.font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: WPShield — security gateway for WordPress on Windows Server and IIS
svg.desc: A dark 1280 by 640 card. An amber RESEARCH PREVIEW badge sits above the WPShield wordmark and the line Security gateway for WordPress on Windows Server and IIS. Below a divider, three red-outlined chips show the file names invoice.php.jpg scoring 80 under WP-UPLOAD-001 and 002, shell.php. scoring 100 under WP-UPLOAD-001 and FILE-NAME-001, and web.config scoring 100 under IIS-CONFIG-001. A caption reads that WPShield scores the name Windows will actually write, not the name that was sent. The footer carries github.com/peopleworks/WPShield and the line .NET 10, MIT, PeopleWorks.
svg.text: Security gateway for WordPress on Windows Server + IIS
